jobs.occupation: Chief Engineer - Tissue Machine Controls & Automation
jobs.description:
Would you like to take the technical lead in projects delivering automation solutions for modern tissue machines around the world, while also helping us develop the way we work?
We are looking for a Chief Engineer to join Valmet's Tissue Machine Controls & Automation department. We design, develop, and commission automation solutions for project deliveries in Sweden and internationally, ranging from new tissue mills to large machine rebuilds and service projects. As customers increasingly look for integrated solutions and value throughout the entire machine lifecycle, automation is becoming an ever more important part of our offering.
Within the department, we work closely across disciplines including electrical engineering, software programming, hydraulics, pneumatics, lubrication systems, and piping design. We also collaborate closely with project management, other departments, and our customers. The field is developing rapidly, particularly within digitalization, which means there are always new challenges and opportunities to learn. Our projects are a team effort across the entire department. As Chief Engineer, you will coordinate our work and act as the main project manager's key partner for Controls & Automation matters.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading, planning, and following up the department’s work in projects together with colleagues from all our engineering disciplines.
Acting as the link between the project team and the main project manager regarding status, risks, technical decisions, and design reviews.
Contributing technical expertise in electrical engineering and machinery safety, including risk assessments, safety functions, and verification of our deliveries, together with relevant specialists.
Sharing experience and lessons learned across projects and taking an active role in developing common, globally scalable ways of working.
International travel is part of the role.

Who we are looking for
We believe you have:
A Master's or Bachelor's degree in engineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience.
Strong knowledge of automation and electrical engineering, with experience in designing industrial electrical systems and applying electrical engineering and machinery safety requirements in machine projects.
Solid experience in leading projects or technical engineering work.
Very good spoken and written English.

It is considered an advantage if you have:
Relevant certifications in electrical engineering, electrical safety, or machinery safety, for example an expert-level machinery safety certification.
Experience from the pulp and paper industry.
Knowledge of additional languages.

As a person, you are engaged and curious, and you enjoy collaborating and building trust with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. You take responsibility for the bigger picture, lead through clarity and dialogue, and help others succeed.
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

What we offer
A role where you can make a real impact in an international company, with technical decisions that directly contribute to our customers' success and to safe, sustainable installations.
You will work with knowledgeable and supportive colleagues and have excellent opportunities to develop both technically and as a leader. At Valmet, we believe that different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives lead to better solutions for our customers. We therefore welcome all applicants, regardless of gender, age, or background.
Do you recognize yourself in much of the description, but perhaps not everything? Apply anyway. We would be happy to hear from you.
Additional information
If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 10, by filling in our online application form. For further information about the position, please contact Jonas Johansson, Senior Manager Controls & Automation Advanced Machines Product Group, at +46 766 397 734.
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. 
When everything works together  
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.   
At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.  
Join the team – and lead the way with us!

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in machine learning for materials design
jobs.description:
Work assignments 
The primary focus of the position is on developing and applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methods for large-scale computational materials discovery. The research aims to advance data-driven materials science through the development of methods for exploring vast spaces of possible materials, identifying promising candidates, and guiding the discovery and design of new materials with desired properties.
 
The work includes the development and application of physics-informed machine learning models, generative AI methods, machine learning interatomic potentials, and high-throughput computational workflows. The research may also involve computational physics methods, studies of materials stability and properties, and data-driven approaches to understanding and predicting materials synthesizability.
 
Particular emphasis will be placed on efficient methods and software for massively parallel GPU-accelerated computations on high-performance computing (HPC) systems. The aim is to contribute to our AI-driven materials design platform to enable large-scale screening and inverse design of materials, with potential applications in, e.g., quantum information processing, energy storage, and electronic and optoelectronic devices.
As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.
Qualifications
To be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree.  This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.
It is considered advantageous if your doctoral degree is no older than three years at application deadline for this job. If there are special reasons for having an older doctoral degree – such as taking statutory leave – then these may be taken into consideration.
Your application must include documents that clearly show that you fulfill the following requirements for the position:
A doctoral degree in physics, materials science, computational science, or equivalent. A course transcript with grades must be included in the application. 
A publication list that includes multiple co-authored research publications in computational materials science, materials informatics, machine learning, and/or related areas of computational science.
Co-authored publications demonstrating experience with the development or application of AI/machine learning methods for prediction of materials properties or other applications in materials discovery.
Experience with high-throughput computational materials science, automated computational workflows, or large-scale materials datasets.
Extensive documented programming experience, particularly in Python, demonstrated, for example, through co-authored publications describing the use of Python and links to open-source software to which the applicant has contributed.

It is considered a strong merit for the position if your application shows documented experience, in particular in relation to materials science, of (i) developing new AI/machine learning methods (beyond applying existing ones); (ii) experience with generative AI methods, such as flow matching and diffusion models; (iii) development or fine-tuning of machine learning interatomic potentials; (iv) GPU-accelerated computing and high-performance computing (HPC), particularly using Python-based frameworks such as JAX.
It is considered a merit for the position if your application shows other documented experience demonstrating a high level of understanding and skill in the fields of solid-state physics, thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, crystallography, and crystal symmetries.
You are expected to be creative, independent, and intellectually curious, and to have a high level of engagement and motivation to contribute to materials science and the development of AI-driven methods for materials discovery.
The workplace
More information at: https://liu.se/en/research/materials-design-and-informatics
The employment
This employment is a temporary contract of two years with the possibility of extension up to a total maximum of three years.
 
The employment is full-time.
Starting date by agreement.
Salary and employment benefits
At Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.
More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.
Union representatives
Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.
Application procedure
Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 17 December, 2026. 
 
 
 
Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. 
 
 
 
Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application. 
Please note that printed publications will not be returned. They will be archived at Linköping University. 
 
 
 
In the event of a discrepancy between the English translation of the job announcement and the Swedish original, the Swedish version shall take precedent. 
 
We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.
 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

Would you like to work with modern cloud technology and build secure digital solutions used in critical business processes?
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our CLM & eSign team in Solna. You’ll work with modern cloud-based technology, take ownership of technical decisions and help us build scalable, secure solutions for digital signing and contract lifecycle management.
About us
At Verified, we build cloud-based solutions for identity verification, electronic signing and Anti-Money Laundering (AML). Our platform supports AML/KYC, supplier due diligence and secure digital workflows.
We’re around 100 people, mainly serving the Nordic market, with a user network that spans Europe. Our API-first platform lets businesses integrate secure, scalable services into their existing systems and workflows.
Technology is at the heart of what we do, and we keep investing in cloud infrastructure, scalable architecture and AI-driven solutions. Our engineers work in autonomous, cross-functional teams with shared ownership, a strong engineering culture and a real say in how our products and technology evolve.
The role and the team
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you’ll help develop and scale our cloud-based CLM and eSign platform. You’ll work across frontend, backend and cloud infrastructure, with significant influence over architecture and technical decisions.
You’ll join a collaborative, cross-functional engineering team where developers own the full development lifecycle, from system design and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. We work closely across different parts of the platform, with a strong focus on technical quality, knowledge sharing and building reliable solutions.
You’ll be working with a modern, scalable stack built on microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architecture. Our backend runs primarily on C# (ASP.NET Core and .NET Framework) alongside Node.js, while the frontend combines React with ASP.NET MVC (Razor). Everything is hosted on AWS - leveraging ECS, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and Elasticsearch to power different parts of the platform.
In the role, you will:

Design and develop scalable cloud-based systems, REST APIs and modern web applications.

Contribute to architecture and technical decisions, building resilient microservices with AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and event-driven systems.

Develop integrations, manage complex workflows, asynchronous processes and help evolve the shared infrastructure for our CLM and eSign services.

Drive engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD and production monitoring.

Use AI agents, RAG and automated workflows to improve our products and development processes.

AI is an important investment area for us. Our engineering organisation is exploring a more agentic approach to software development, so you’ll have the chance to shape how AI is used across the development lifecycle and built into our products.
We see software engineering as a craft, where technical quality, thoughtful decisions and pragmatic solutions go hand in hand.
What will you bring to the team?
At least five years of experience in software development, preferably in cloud-based SaaS environments.

Strong experience with ASP.NET Core, C# .NET and Node.js, alongside React.

Experience building REST APIs, microservices and distributed systems.

A good understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous communication.

Hands-on experience with AWS and databases such as SQL Server and DynamoDB.

A strong understanding of system design, security, scalability and modern application architecture.

Experience with, or an interest in, AI tools and modern development workflows.

Professional proficiency in English and the right to work in Sweden.

It’s good to have experience working with real-time communication using SignalR, command-query separation (CQS) patterns and Event Sourcing. It’s also a plus if you’ve worked with third-party integrations or in regulated industries such as FinTech and RegTech.
As a person, you’re curious, analytical and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership. You enjoy technical discussions, sharing knowledge and finding practical solutions that balance quality, performance and business needs.
What we offer
With us, you’ll work on technology that helps businesses manage critical digital processes securely and efficiently. You’ll join an experienced engineering environment with significant influence over architecture, technical decisions and development practices, and you’ll help shape how we use AI and modern technologies across Verified.

Significant influence over technical decisions and product development.

An experienced team with a high degree of autonomy and shared ownership.

Modern cloud technology, distributed systems and AI-driven development.

30 days of vacation, plus five “Verified days” for bridge days and holiday flexibility.

Wellness allowance and occupational pension.

A hybrid model and prefer working together from our Solna office 2-3 days per week.

Office breakfasts and snacks, social activities and one moving day per year.

Other information
Start: According to agreement 

Extent: Full time

Location: Our Stockholm office in Solna

The recruitment process
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply!
We’re running this recruitment together with our partner Detechtiv. If you have any questions about the role or the process, contact Oliver at Oliver@detechtiv.se
Our selection process is continuous, and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the screening or interview phase.

Job Title: PSIRT Operational Specialist
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let's make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
 
Role Summary

Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the future of secure and sustainable transportation. As an PSIRT Operational Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting connected vehicles, digital platforms, and services from evolving cyber threats. Working within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will move between incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity risk mitigation across our products and ecosystems.
This role combines both operational and tactical responsibilities. You will collaborate with experts across Vehicle Security Operations, Cybersecurity Testing, Product Development, Safety, Compliance, and Engineering to ensure the highest level of cybersecurity resilience throughout the product lifecycle.
If you are passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to contribute to products that impact millions of people worldwide, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
 
Job Responsibilities

As a PSIRT Operational Specialist, you will:
· Analyze cybersecurity incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks, including assessment of CVEs, CPEs, and CVSS scores, as well as disclosure management.
· Contribute to, and when ready coordinate or lead, cross-functional incident triage, forensic investigations, and response activities.
· Contribute to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of PSIRT playbooks, security procedures, and incident readiness plans.
· Configure, validate, and support our security tools and technologies.
· Support in compliance activities related to cybersecurity regulations and standards such as ISO 21434 and UNECE R155.
· Stay informed about emerging cyber threats, technology trends, and industry developments to proactively develop our security capabilities.
 
Who You Are

You are a driven and proactive cybersecurity professional who thrives in a technical environment and enjoys collaborating across teams, functions, and cultures. You can balance tactical thinking with hands-on execution and remain calm in critical situations.
We believe you have:
· Experience from cybersecurity operations, incident response, vulnerability analysis, PSIRT, SOC, or automotive cybersecurity environments.
· A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
· Experience from evaluating security risks, threats, or vulnerabilities.
· A structured and detail-oriented approach combined with strong integrity and professionalism.
· Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
· And, a strong interest in emerging technologies and cybersecurity threats
 
It is a plus if you have:
· Experience from working with automotive EE systems, connected vehicles, or embedded systems software.
· Knowledge of ISO 21434, UNECE R155, CRA, digital forensics, or threat intelligence.
· Security certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, OSCP, or CompTIA Security+.
· Experience contributing to security communities such as FIRST, ENISA, CSIRT networks, or similar.
 
This Is Us

We are a collaborative and skilled cybersecurity team responsible for protecting TRATON's products and services from evolving cyber threats. Expanding across brands, technologies, and international teams, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong culture of trust, continuous learning, and teamwork.
Our mission is not only to respond to cybersecurity incidents, but also to proactively strengthen security capabilities, improve resilience, and support the secure development of future transportation solutions. With us, your actions will have a direct impact on the company's cybersecurity status.
 
Who Is Your Manager
I am here to support you and the whole team in being successful and taking the necessary steps toward fulfilling our goals and stakeholders' expectations. I believe in creating a safe, transparent, and collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, challenge assumptions, and contribute to better solutions.
Our work is challenging yet meaningful, which is why I prioritize trust, teamwork, and personal development and growth. Just as important, I value work-life balance and the well-being of every individual in the team.
 
Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Jenny Holmqvist, Manager in CS Monitoring & Incident Response jenny.holmqvist@scania.com.

We look forward to your application!

Job Title: Process Manager - Data Management & People Analytics
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
 
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

We are looking for a Process Manager Data Management & People Analytics to strengthen how People data and analytics support business decisions within our assigned Business Areas and the Finance and P&C Communities.  
In this business-oriented role, you will connect business needs with global P&C processes, data governance and analytics capabilities. Working from a dual perspective, you will support the adoption of global standards within our Business Areas while contributing to the priorities of the Finance and P&C Communities. As part of the Cross Area Team, you will also contribute to broader initiatives where your expertise adds value, adapting to changing business needs and priorities. 
 
Job Responsibilities
Your main responsibilities will include:
 
Connect business needs with data and People analytics: Identify opportunities where People Analytics can improve decision-making and translate business needs into data, reporting and analytics requirements. 
Strengthen data quality and governance: Support the adoption of global P&C processes, data standards and definitions. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, clarify ownership and resolve issues through established governance channels. 
Enable self-service and data-driven ways of working: Guide and train stakeholders in using trusted People data, analytics tools and insights in everyday decisions. 
Drive collaboration, change and adoption: Work across business functions, P&C and specialist teams to facilitate discussions, build alignment and support sustainable behavioural change. 
Support AI-related transformation: Help turn AI capabilities into practical business value, supporting adoption and contributing to the team's AI upskilling journey. 

Enable actionable insights: Support the development and use of People Analytics, reports and dashboards to help stakeholders understand trends and make informed decisions.
 
Who You Are
We believe you are an experienced P&C professional with a background in similar business-facing roles or P&C Business Partnering, combining broad P&C understanding with Data Management & People Analytics capabilities. 
You enjoy working close to the business, navigating organisational complexity and turning People data into meaningful insights and business value. You build strong stakeholder relationships and thrive in a changing environment where priorities evolve.

Proven experience with HR data, People Analytics, data governance, reporting, business intelligence or HR process management. 
Good understanding of data management principles, including governance, stewardship, data quality, ownership and accessibility. 
Ability to identify analytics opportunities, translate business needs into actionable insights, and perform basic analysis, reporting and visualisation. 
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with experience supporting change and adoption. 
Fluency in written and spoken English. 
A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Management, Analytics, Information Systems or a related field. 

Experience with self-service analytics, digital transformation or AI-related change would be an advantage.
 
This Is Us

Our team works close to the business, connecting business needs with P&C expertise and turning strategic priorities into practical results. We value collaboration, flexibility and the ability to navigate organisational complexity and changing priorities. 
The role offers an opportunity to combine your P&C experience with Data Management & People Analytics, contribute to better business decisions and help develop more effective, data-driven ways of working within our Business Areas and the Finance and P&C Communities. 
We encourage curiosity, continuous learning and the willingness to explore how AI and new technologies can create business value.
 
Scania Offers

The research group focuses on improving diagnostics and advancing our understanding of central nervous system (CNS) tumours through epigenetic and molecular approaches. Independent development, implementation, and optimisation of bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines for large-scale sequencing data.

Development of computational approaches for the analysis of RNA modifications from sequencing data.
Integration of genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data through advanced multiomics analyses.
Development of robust and reproducible computational pipelines, including evaluation and validation of novel analytical methods.
Independent statistical analysis, visualisation, and biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Scientific responsibility for the bioinformatic aspects of research projects, including study design, methodological decisions, data interpretation, and scientific publication.
Collaboration with experimental and clinical researchers, as well as supervision of junior researchers and students in bioinformatics.

PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or another relevant discipline with a strong computational focus.
Several years of documented experience in independent bioinformatic research and computational method development.
Extensive expertise in the analysis of large-scale sequencing data, particularly DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing.
Documented experience in developing and implementing bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines.
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of DNA methylation and other epigenetic modifications.
Experience in the analysis of liquid biopsy data, RNA modifications, and/or integrated multiomics datasets.
Excellent programming skills, for example in Python and R, and experience working in Linux-based computational environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, conduct, and lead bioinformatic research projects.
A strong scientific publication record in relevant research areas.
Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

Meriting qualifications
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of liquid biopsy data using nanopore sequencing and EM-seq.
Experience in developing methods for identifying RNA modifications from nanopore-based direct RNA sequencing.
In-depth knowledge of epigenetics, DNA methylation, and epigenetic tumour classification.
Research experience in CNS tumours or other areas of cancer research.
Experience in integrating genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic datasets.
Experience with high-performance computing (HPC), version control, and reproducible computational workflows.
Experience in translational research and the development of bioinformatic methods for diagnostic applications.

The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.
Employment information
 
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
 
Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-31
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Datavetenskap och datateknik
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum Computing
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.
This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  
Assessment criteria
For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on: 
Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit
Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit
Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit

Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
